description: An enqueue whose base_branch is not a branch the named repository has: ErrMergeQueueBaseUnknown. The queue lane is keyed (component_root, base_branch); a lane onto a branch nobody can check out would merge nothing into nowhere. The refusal never lists the branches the repository DOES have — that is the component's own read.

error.message: that base branch does not exist for that repository

data.what: base branch "release" is not known for this repository (known: [main]) — the loop pin, the component's default branch, or origin/HEAD decide a base
data.means: nothing enqueued. A queue lane is keyed (component_root, base_branch); a lane onto a branch nobody can check out would merge nothing into nowhere
data.todo: name the repository's real base (mergequeue.status answers the lanes this repository already has), or create the base branch first
